_rules: Source of truth for requirement status. Created by swe-requirements-engineer from docs/PRD.md.
Build agents may ONLY change: status, tests, verified_by, verified_on, milestone, modules.
Never delete an entry or edit id/title/criteria. Scope changes go through a change request (requirements engineer + PRD changelog); removed items get status 'withdrawn'.

status 'pass' only after the criteria were actually verified (tests run green AND, for user-facing items, the journey exercised end to end). verified_by must be a different agent/role than the implementer.
